paragraphs: Mentioned in Arakhin 16b, asking R' Chanina. Some say he was R' Chanina's son-in-law; others say he asked R' Yehoshua ben Levi.[^1]

notes.text: טז: gives 16b by convention without new passage verification. מ־ in מר׳/מרי״בל marks the person asked, not the name Mar; the headed Shmuel asks, rather than being asked. Yehoshua ben Levi is the contextual conventional initials expansion with title R'. Both successive some-say alternatives remain, including the son-in-law relationship. Full heading רב is Rav; both Chanina title occurrences remain R'.
